# Revelo

> > Revelo is a nearshore staffing platform connecting US companies with pre-vetted Latin American engineers for full-time remote roles, offering managed payroll, compliance, and AI training data services.

Revelo specializes in nearshore talent acquisition from Latin America, providing access to over 400K vetted engineers across multiple specializations. The platform handles payroll, compliance, and legal requirements while offering flexible hiring without long-term contracts.

## Key Topics

- Nearshore staffing

- Backend developers

- QA engineers

- LLM training data
